Full summary: Post-ship bookkeeping only: updated the persistent auto-memory index (MEMORY.md + project_wave2_field_defects.md, outside the repo) to reflect 2.13.0 shipped, the review-caught majors, and the trimmed backlog. No repo files changed since the last record.
Findings: The stop hook's edit marker again counted writes OUTSIDE the repo (the ~/.claude auto-memory files) as session edits requiring a record — same class as the known subagent false-positive; harmless but noisy
